text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as the entire academy was buzzing
in preparation for the U.A.F.—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh... Behold, this glorious piece of art!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "Behold the endless banquet of cycles woven by the sub-deity harboring the dual extremities of color—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Ah.

text_block_list.name: Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Just tell me already, Senpai!! You're participating in the "U.A.F.", right?!

text_block_list.name: Shaved-Head Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You're definitely gonna win, Sirius-senpai! Show us how truly unstoppable you are!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Ridiculous.
Listen here, whether I enter or not is for me to decide.
If you understand, be quiet for a――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whiiiiistle*)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk. Watch it. Who the hell did that?

text_block_list.name: Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Trapping a ball that came flying out of nowhere like that... Sirius-senpai really is insane!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Quit your chirping.
Something like this doesn't even count as child's play—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hup!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Just wait for the main event—I'll show you something even better...

text_block_list.name: Junior who Admires Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Lady Ramonu, such a devoted gaze.
If only you would turn that warmth toward me
instead of toward that book...

text_block_list.name: Sociable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You're better off just keeping it a dream.
A fan who tried making a scene to get her attention before
burst into tears when she didn't even spare them a glance...

text_block_list.name: Junior who Admires Ramonu
text_block_list.text: My! It is only natural to ignore such vulgar folk—oh, what was that sound?

text_block_list.name: Sociable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why is there a ball?!
Uh-oh! It's heading straight for Ramonu-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SMAAACK!)

text_block_list.name: Sociable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No way...!!
A volley without even looking at the ball!?

text_block_list.name: Junior who Admires Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah!!!! What an incredible kick!
I... I want to be that ball—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: How noisy.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Now then, where could the lost child have hidden away—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ……Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you return once more, my subordinate deity.
And so, the cycle of reincarnation continues—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was one scene from a grand adventure
experienced by a certain soccer ball—
